HxResult HxPinWheelDelete ( HxPinWheel_t *  pPinWheel  ) 

Delete a pinwheel widget.

HxPinWheelDelete deletes a pinwheel created from an earlier call to HxPinWheelNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxPinWheelDelete only needs to be called when deleting a pinwheel widget at runtime.

Parameters:
pPinWheel IN: Pointer to the pinwheel to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxPinWheelNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
int32_t  x,
int32_t  y,
HxPinWheel_t **  hPinWheel 
)

Create a pinwheel widget.

HxPinWheelNew creates a new pinwheel widget. This is an animated widget that an application can use to represent indeterminate progress. It should be used when the application is performing a lengthy operation that blocks the event loop from running, and indicates to users that the system is not deadlocked.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing label
x IN: X coordinate of the top left corner.
y IN: Y coordinate of the top left corner.
hPinWheel OUT: Handle to the new pinwheel; *hPinWheel is NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hPinWheel to NULL.
